chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray with one prayer unless he has fulfilled the obligatory duty.
So if he has fulfilled it, there is no harm in praying it as a voluntary prayer.
ai.seo_question: Can I pray my obligatory prayer again as a voluntary prayer?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (AS) clarification that one cannot perform the same prayer twice—once as obligatory (*fard*) and once as voluntary (*nafl*)—unless the obligatory portion is already complete, preventing redundancy in worship. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that *nafl* prayers serve to supplement or perfect the *fard*, rather than merely repeating it, ensuring the spiritual integrity and distinct purpose of each act of devotion. The narration highlights the precision with which the Imams delineated the boundaries of ritual validity to maintain both legal correctness and spiritual sincerity.
